name: resolume: arena (only osc)
description: Resolume Arena OSC module for Bitfocus Companion. Clip/column triggering, layer opacity, BPM (range-normalized), preset slots, group columns, velocity encoders, loop-hold automation, real-time progress bars with a network-friendly polling toggle, OSC connection diagnostics (ping/jitter), and a Quick Control Panel of bypass-until-activated buttons for paint/mass-delete/diagnostics.
